description: This file defines a ResidentStorage class responsible for managing persistent storage of Resident objects using SharedPreferences. It includes methods to load residents, save residents, internal seed data, and maintains versioned keys for storage consistency.

classes.name: ResidentStorage
classes.description: A class that manages storing and retrieving Resident objects using SharedPreferences, including seeding initial data.

methods.name: loadResidents
methods.description: Loads the list of residents from persistent storage, seeding initial data if not already seeded.

methods.name: saveResidents
methods.description: Saves the provided list of Resident objects to persistent storage.

methods.name: _saveResidentsInternal
methods.description: Internal method to encode and store residents list into SharedPreferences.

methods.name: _seedResidents
methods.description: Provides a set of initial Resident objects for seeding the app's storage.
